args.title: checkout-api hotfix v2.3.2 deployed to production
args.summary: Deployed hotfix v2.3.2 to all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) to address unhealthy v2.3.1 (error rate 0.18). Deployment verified/rolled out. Recording the change per runbook.

trace.final:
Both actions are complete. Here's a summary:

## Summary

**1. Deployed checkout-api hotfix v2.3.2 to all production regions**
- Prior state: production was running v2.3.1, which was **unhealthy** (error rate 0.18) across us-east, us-west, and eu-west.
- Deployed v2.3.2 to all three production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west). The deployment returned `status: rolled_out` / `VERIFIED`.

**2. Opened SEV3 incident recording the change**
- Created incident **INC-0001** ("checkout-api hotfix v2.3.2 deployed to production") with severity SEV3 for checkout-api, documenting the deployment of the hotfix to address the unhealthy v2.3.1 release. The on-call engineer was paged as part of the incident creation.

Note: I did not roll back to a previously healthy version (e.g., v2.3.0) since the explicit instruction was to ship the v2.3.2 hotfix; the incident records the change as requested.
